rules.title: Compound assignment operators
rules.statement: The compound-assignment operators are `+=` `-=` `*=` `/=` `%=` `&=` `|=` `^=` `<<=` `>>=`. A compound-assign statement is `place OP value ;` where `place` is an atom (postfix-chained lvalue) and `value` is a full `expr`.

rules.title: Dereference write statement
rules.statement: `* p = v ;` writes value `v` through dereferenced place `p` (a `unary_expr`). `* p OP v ;` performs compound assignment through a bare dereference and is defined to lower to `*p = *p OP v`.
rules.divergence: Logos addition: distinct DEREF_WRITE/DEREF_COMPOUND statement forms; semantics match Rust place-expression assignment.

rules.title: Function-style macro invocation
rules.statement: Function-style macros invoke as `name!(…)`, `name![…]`, or `name!{…}`; the contents between balanced delimiters are captured as raw source text and re-interpreted at sema time per the callee's macro kind (#[fn_macro] re-parses as an expression list; #[token_macro] lexes as a TokenStream). In no-struct-lit (condition) position the brace form `name!{…}` is excluded.

rules.title: Variadic pack size and expansion
rules.statement: `P...(N)` yields the length of variadic pack `P` (sizeof-pack), and `P...` in expression position expands the pack `P`.

rules.title: Writ SDN literals
rules.statement: Writ structured-data literals use the `@` sigil: `@{k:v,…}` map, `@[v,…]` array, `@"s"` string, `@42`/`@-1` int, `@<float>` float, `@true`/`@false` bool, `@null`. Typed forms `@<Elem>[…]` (dense array) and `@<K,V>{…}` / `@<K>{…}` (typed map). Comprehension forms `@[expr for x in iter (if p)?]` and `@{k:v for …}`. Only the outermost literal needs the `@` sigil; inner values are plain.
rules.divergence: Logos addition: Writ self-describing data-notation literals.

rules.title: Binary operator precedence
rules.statement: Binary precedence, lowest→highest: logical (`&&`/`||`) < comparison (`==` `!=` `<=` `>=` `<` `>`) < bitor `|` < bitxor `^` < bitand `&` < shift (`<<` `>>`) < additive (`+` `-`) < multiplicative (`*` `/` `%`) < `as`-cast < unary. All binary levels are left-associative. The same cascade exists in two parallel forms — the ordinary one (`log_expr` … `cast_expr`) and the no-struct-lit one (`log_expr_ns` … `cast_expr_ns`) used in if/while/for condition position, where a trailing `IDENT { ... }` would otherwise be greedily parsed as a struct literal.

rules.title: Try operator
rules.statement: Postfix `e?` (`TRY_EXPR`) is the try operator; it propagates the error/none case of a Result/Option-like receiver and yields the success payload.

rules.title: metacall expression forms
rules.statement: `metacall` accepts exactly three operand shapes — a block (`metacall { … }`), a parenthesized expression (`metacall (e)`), or a call expression (`metacall f(…)`, including generic `f::<T>(…)` and static `Type::m(…)`) — and evaluates its argument at compile time.
rules.divergence: A1/A6 — Logos addition: metacall is the explicit compile-time evaluation operator, the Logos replacement for const-eval (no implicit const-eval).
